description: This file defines the CloudStore class, which implements a plugin for the WPEFramework. It includes nested classes for configuration, notifications, and remote connection handling, and declares methods for initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval. The class interacts with external interfaces such as IStore2 and JSONRPC, and manages internal state related to service connection and store interactions.

classes.name: CloudStore
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing IPlugin and JSONRPC interfaces, managing store notifications and remote connection events.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Configuration container class holding the URI setting for the CloudStore plugin.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Notification handler for store value changes, forwarding events to the parent CloudStore.

classes.name: RemoteConnectionNotification
classes.description: Notification handler for remote connection events, triggering deactivation procedures when a connection is deactivated.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the CloudStore plugin with the provided service context.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with the plugin.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.
